purpose: Apply the pre-registered predictive stop rule, run nested spatial validation only for candidates still eligible after temporal OOF, and lock the final production/scientific status without creating 20260824_44+.
clear_temporal_failure: delta station-macro log-RMSE > 0.01 and paired station bootstrap CI95 lower > 0
early_stop: If every new candidate is a clear temporal failure against the corresponding Stage32 P1/population layer, do not spend additional TN information or computation on nested LORO/LOTO, natural expansion, or full-development refit; retain the locked Stage32 production model.

dryad_completion_amendment_before_nested.trigger: After replacing the temporary Shao forcing with the already-registered Dryad primary constraint, ActiveLegacy_v2__IMM0 significantly improved over its identical-ledger KFAST control in temporal population OOF (CI95 upper < 0).
dryad_completion_amendment_before_nested.scope: Run nested LORO, LOTO and natural expansion for ActiveLegacy_v2__IMM0 versus ActiveLegacy_v2__KFAST_CONTROL only. Stage41 R0/R1 remain stopped because they are clear failures versus Stage32 and R1 is additionally extrapolation-confounded.
dryad_completion_amendment_before_nested.production_boundary: The nested run can support or reject the agricultural slow-release mechanism as a nonproduction scientific scenario; it cannot promote either Dryad-ledger candidate over Stage32 because both are already clear temporal failures versus Stage32.
dryad_completion_amendment_before_nested.cold_start_rule: Every spatial fold uses only deterministic model.initial multistarts; no checkpoint or initialization that saw held-out Reach/tree/station TN is allowed.
required_comparisons: Active versus KFAST LORO paired Reach-block CI95 upper < 0.005
Active versus KFAST LOTO paired tree-block CI95 upper < 0.005
Active versus KFAST natural expansion station-block and Reach-block CI95 upper < 0.005
LORO and LOTO station-blind log-skill CI95 lower > 0 for Active

conditional_rule: conditional performance is reported but cannot rescue a population clear failure

nested_spatial_if_temporally_eligible.LORO: refit all allowed shared parameters after removing the held-out Reach
nested_spatial_if_temporally_eligible.LOTO: refit all allowed shared parameters after removing the held-out terminal tree

final_refit_if_promoted: 2021-2024 all formal TN, same model and priors, before writing a new production artifact
no_promotion_action: Do not overwrite E:/SPARROW/0_reach_topology/data/processed/tn_long_history_mainline or the 20260824_32 lock.
forbidden: overwrite Stage32 production files on failure
